readme: Declarative list read by tools/fetch-assets.mjs. Every entry is a Microsoft Rocketbox file (MIT) at one pinned commit, installed into the gitignored assets-src/people/ (never served). gitBlobSha1 and bytes are what the GitHub contents API lists for that commit; the gate refuses any download whose git blob id differs. sha256 is null until the first fetch: the gate then writes it back here and every later fetch and --verify must match it (commit the pinned hashes). Entries with a localFile are imported from assets-src/_import (verified copies of the Waltz reference files, sha256 already pinned) and never downloaded. Entries of kind textures and hdri are CC0 files from Poly Haven (dl.polyhaven.org, 1k/2k jpg and hdr only), installed into the gitignored assets-src/textures/<asset id>/ and assets-src/hdri/ (never served); they have no gitBlobSha1 (no commit to pin): their pin is bytes plus sha256, written back at the first fetch.
